title: Page scrolls horizontally at 1024 px (pre-existing)
description: Found in stage 2 review: at a 1024 px viewport documentElement.scrollWidth exceeds the viewport (1113 px now; 1413 px at the commit before stage 2). Terra traced it to absolutely positioned screen-reader-only text escaping the board's clipping context. Not a regression, left unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: documentElement.scrollWidth <= viewport width at 1400, 1200, 1024 and 390 px
